overview: A warm, professional public-awareness platform that explains overlooked physical and mental wellbeing issues through reliable information, human stories, and an educational AI helper.
features: Explore Physical and Mental Wellbeing issues in a magazine-style layout
Read dedicated pages for each problem with causes, effects, and what can help
